opener: Father, I have asked so many times that I am starting to feel foolish asking again. The report hasn't changed — I go, I look, I come back and tell You there is nothing — and I'm tempted to stop walking back to the shore before the sixth no becomes a seventh.
paragraphs: You never once told the servant he was asking too much. You just let him go again. So I bring You the same request tonight that I brought You last month, the one I'm almost embarrassed to still be praying: the marriage that hasn't softened, the diagnosis that hasn't moved, the door that hasn't opened. I'm not asking because I think You forgot. I'm asking because the vision is for an appointed time, and I don't get to decide it's over just because it's taking longer than I wanted.

So tonight I go again — not with more noise, just with more nerve. Build in me whatever it was that kept Elijah bowed down on that mountain through six nothings: not denial, just refusal to quit before the cloud shows up. Let me be found still asking, still watching the horizon, when the small thing that looks like nothing turns out to be everything. In Jesus' name, amen.
